definitions.explanation: Matcha prepared thick in the tea ceremony: a large amount of powdered tea kneaded with a little water into a glossy paste-like drink, traditionally shared from one bowl by the guests. It is the formal center of a full tea gathering.

examples.japanese: {濃茶|こいちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
{濃茶|こいちゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{回|まわ}し{飲|の}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thick tea is passed round and shared from one bowl.

examples.japanese: {濃茶|こいちゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{苦|にが}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{上等|じょうとう}→上等：03821_joutou⟧な⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まろやか→まろやか：09207_maroyaka⟧だ。
examples.english: Thick tea looks bitter, but since it uses fine matcha it is surprisingly mellow.

notes:
The tea ceremony serves matcha two ways: {濃茶|こいちゃ}, kneaded (⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧) thick and shared, and ⟦{薄茶|うすちゃ}→薄茶：32160_usucha⟧, whisked thin and frothy, one bowl per guest. {濃茶|こいちゃ} uses higher-grade tea and comes first in a formal gathering ({茶事|ちゃじ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃茶|こいちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to knead (prepare) thick tea
- {濃茶|こいちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点前|てまえ}: the procedure for making thick tea
- {濃茶|こいちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧: to be served thick tea

WRITING:
- Read こいちゃ in the tea ceremony; the same characters read ⟦のう→ない：01118_nai⟧ちゃ can mean any strong tea, and {濃|こ}い{茶色|ちゃいろ} is dark brown.
